The site is Foxhill Orchard & Press — Seasonal Cider Pre-Orders, a web-shop web application for Seasonal cider pre-orders and local pickup.

Owner brief: "Our heritage orchard produces small-batch seasonal cider that sells out quickly every autumn. We need a simple web store where local buyers can view current pressing varieties, add bottles to an order, and choose a weekend farm gate pickup date. Orders must persist on the server so that reopening the confirmation link displays their allocated pickup slot and summary."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-02/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Foxhill Orchard & Press — Seasonal Cider Pre-Orders: the page for seasonal cider pre-orders and local pickup, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #fdfbf7 (fo-bg), #382013 (fo-bark), #b45309 (fo-amber), #f59e0b (fo-gold), #fef3c7 (fo-cream), #e2d9cc (fo-border), #261a12 (fo-text), #786657 (fo-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--fo-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a price or total that cannot be traced back to a listed item; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Foxhill Orchard & Press — Seasonal Cider Pre-Orders as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Customer name", "Email address", "Cider variety", "Total bottle quantity", "Pickup date", "Collection slot", "Order summary").

User journey context: View available cider varieties, adjust bottle quantities, and add items to cart. Proceed to checkout, enter customer contact information, and choose a collection date. Submit the pre-order, see the confirmation reference, and reload to ensure the order is intact.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
